episodeTitle.en: Building Anchor, selling to Spotify, and lessons learned | Maya Prohovnik (Head of Podcast Product)
episodeTitle.zh: 构建锚点、向Spotify出售产品及经验教训 | 玛雅·普罗霍夫尼克（Maya Prohovnik，Podcast产品负责人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Maya Prohovnik is currently Spotify’s Head of Podcast Product. She was employee #1 at Anchor, which was acquired by Spotify in 2019 and now powers more than 80% of all new podcasts created in the world. In 2023, Maya was named one of the Most Important People in Podcasting by The Hollywood Reporter. In today’s episode, we discuss:• How Maya operationalizes “dogfooding”• How to balance data-driven decision-making and intuition• Strategies for preserving startup culture in a large organization• Tactical tips to improve at public speaking• How Radical Candor and the Eisenhower matrix transformed her approach to managing people• What’s next at Spotify for Podcasters
guestBioOfficial.zh: 玛雅·普罗霍夫尼克目前是Spotify的Podcast产品负责人。她曾是Anchor的首位员工，Anchor于2019年被Spotify收购，如今为全球80%以上新创播客提供支持。2023年，玛雅被《好莱坞报道》评为播客界最重要人物之一。在本期节目中，我们探讨了：• 玛雅如何实践“自我反馈”模式   • 如何平衡数据驱动决策与直觉   • 在大组织中保留创业文化的策略   • 提升公开演讲技巧的实用技巧   • 激进坦诚和艾森豪威尔矩阵如何改变她的管理方式   • Spotify面向播客创作者的未来规划

title.en: Building Anchor, selling to Spotify, and lessons learned | Maya Prohovnik (Head of Podcast Product)
title.zh: 构建锚点、向Spotify出售产品及经验教训 | 玛雅·普罗霍夫尼克（Maya Prohovnik，Podcast产品负责人）

summary.en: Maya recounts how the team obsessively reduced friction by quietly having interns manually submit podcasts to Apple behind the scenes, creating a magical one-click experience. She explains this scrappy approach is what drove Anchor's explosive market-share growth. The episode is a lesson in hiding complexity to deliver seeming simplicity at scale.
summary.zh: 玛雅讲述团队如何痴迷于降低摩擦——悄悄让实习生在后台手动把播客提交到 Apple，从而造出"一键发布"的魔法体验。她说明，正是这种灵活务实的做法推动了 Anchor 托管市场份额的爆发式增长。本期是关于"隐藏复杂性、在规模上交付看似简单"的一课。

readingPassages.label: 所以我想问你：为什么“内部测试”对你如此重要？
readingPassages.labelEn: Okay, let's do it. So as the first question I asked a PM who actually works for you, Wilma Chu, what to ask…

readingPassages.label: 你们从中学到了哪些经验，又是如何做到这一点的呢？
readingPassages.labelEn: Okay. And then in terms of operating within Spotify, from what I understand, your team is still very startupy…

readingPassages.label: 最后两个问题：如果有人想联系你，他们可以在哪里找到你的线上资料？
readingPassages.labelEn: Okay. Maya, we've talked about chickens, dogfooding, gut level decisions, Radical Candor, so many things.…
